semiconductor_relevance: Medium — O.C.E. Technology develops software and system-in-package technology specifically for space and safety-critical applications, which are relevant to the semiconductor industry.
summary: O.C.E. Technology specializes in designing and developing software that adheres to quality assurance standards in space and safety-critical fields. They offer a real-time operating system compatible with RISC-V, ARM, and SPARC processors, as well as space-ready system-in-package technology that enhances reliability in harsh environments.
capabilities: Real-time operating system compliant with ESA safety standards
